neighbours.label: The link word after a gear object and a fit-or-use verb ('use old lenses on', 'run these tires on', 'paired it with', 'fitted to'); gear with other verbs, and fixtures being fixed or hung, stay quiet.
fire: I mounted these wheels on my Subaru last fall.
You can run this lens on a crop body.
We paired the amp with small bookshelf speakers.
He fitted a turbo to his old Golf.
They put bigger brakes on the Mustang.
The kit lets you use Nikon glass on a Canon camera.
This rod is best matched with a spinning reel.
Bolt the rack to your Jeep before the trip.
quiet: I washed these wheels in my driveway last fall.
You can buy this lens from a shop downtown.
We carried the amp up to the small attic.
He sold a turbo for his old boss.
They parked the Mustang on the street.
The kit comes in a box from the Canon store.
This rod is stored with the rest in the shed.
Bolt the shelf to your wall before the trip.

notes: Probes: 0.13-0.68 for the frame ('fit old cars with' 0.13, 'fitted to' 0.18, the V8 ' in' 0.27, 'run tires on' 0.65); 'Mount the bracket on the wall' 0.01. 'carry the phone from' (a phone network) read 0.65, and 'hooked it' (fishing) 0.26: these are not covered. The peak token varies.
